title: Attachment of wood shingles over a capillary break
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A Part 9 single-family house addition proposes cedar shingles attached to code-compliant sheathing through a proprietary roll-type product intended to provide a capillary break.

The appellant considered the product an open drainage material meeting the cited thickness/open-area criteria; the building official questioned whether the intervening material changes fastener support and long-term assembly performance.
The cited provisions are Clause 9.27.2.2.(1)(b), Sentence 9.27.5.1.(1), and related attachment provisions.
